input.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return/deletion obligation in Section 4(c)
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 4(c) only addresses cessation of the Services and Confidential Information, so we have added a standard exit clause requiring Kubient to provide up to six (6) months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, return our data in a machine-readable format within thirty (30) days, and certify deletion thereafter. If six months is not workable, we can accept ninety (90) days of transition assistance with the same 30-day data return.

ops.text: (v) upon Customer's request, Kubient shall provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months at Kubient's then-current rates; within thirty (30) days of such request, Kubient shall return to Customer all Content, Requests, reports and other data of or relating to Customer or the Properties then in Kubient's possession or control (collectively, "Customer Data") in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and thereafter Kubient shall delete all Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.
